  • Constructor Details

    • Result

      Result(String name, LNGProcessCycle cycle, double feedMassFlowKgPerHour, double lngMassFlowKgPerHour, double lngYield, double capacityMTPA, double compressorPowerKW, double expanderRecoveredPowerKW, double netPowerKW, double specificEnergyKWhPerKgLNG, double productTemperatureC, double productPressureBara, double productDensityKgPerM3, double minimumInternalTemperatureApproachC, double exchangerExergyDestructionKW, double runTimeMilliseconds)
      Creates an evaluated process result.
      Parameters:
      name - model name
      cycle - process cycle
      feedMassFlowKgPerHour - feed rate in kg/h
      lngMassFlowKgPerHour - liquid LNG product rate in kg/h
      lngYield - liquid mass yield
      capacityMTPA - capacity at 8000 h/y in MTPA
      compressorPowerKW - total compressor power in kW
      expanderRecoveredPowerKW - recovered expander power in kW
      netPowerKW - net shaft power in kW
      specificEnergyKWhPerKgLNG - net specific energy in kWh/kg LNG
      productTemperatureC - product temperature in Celsius
      productPressureBara - product pressure in bara
      productDensityKgPerM3 - product density in kg/m3
      minimumInternalTemperatureApproachC - minimum exchanger approach in Celsius
      exchangerExergyDestructionKW - exchanger exergy destruction in kW
      runTimeMilliseconds - process execution time in milliseconds
